sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is semantically verified: the scoped vocabulary lacks a canonical qualified material-approval/evidence relationship or certificate term that binds each exposed-structure material to its approval authority, standard, polar service temperature basis, and certificate/reference.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The shape only places approval status, authority, standard, and polarServiceTemperature independently on the ship; it does not encode the required qualification that each exposed-structure material's approval evidence is based on that PST and the referenced approval standard. Add a canonical material approval/evidence relationship or qualified approval-record path that binds the material, approval evidence, authority, standard, and PST together, including the approval certificate/reference where required.
